transforms.code:
if (value or None) is None: return []
	instances = []
	sections = value.split("\\")
	for i, section in enumerate(sections):
		width = 0 if section == sections[0] else self.getChild("root").getCharPixelSize('>')	#Adds space for the >
		width += self.getChild("root").getCharPixelSize(section)
		path = "\\".join(sections[:i+1])
		instances.append({'instancePosition': {"basis": str(width + 5) + 'px'}, 'values': {'path':path, 'section': section, 'msgHandler': self.view.params.values.msgHandler, 'selectorId': self.params.values.selectorId}})
		
	return instances

customMethods.script:
if (stringName or None) is None: return 0
	from java.awt import Font
	from java.awt.image import BufferedImage
	fontName="Roboto"
	fontSize=12
	fontStyle=Font.PLAIN
	
	font = Font(fontName, fontStyle, fontSize)
	img = BufferedImage(1, 1, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB)
	g = img.createGraphics()
	g.setFont(font)
	fm = g.getFontMetrics()
	w = fm.stringWidth(stringName)
	h = fm.getHeight()
	g.dispose()
	
	return w

customMethods.script:
#	system.perspective.print("sectionSelected() called with %s"%path)
	if path == self.view.params.values.path: path = "\\".join(path.split("\\")[:-1]) if path else path

	self.view.custom.path = path
	
	params = self.view.params.values
	treePath = params['treePath'] if params['treePath'] else 'path'
		
	payload = {'activity': 'nodeSelected', 'msgHandler': params['msgHandler'], 'selection': [], 'selectorId': self.view.params.values.selectorId}			
	
	if path: payload['selection'] = [{'value': self.view.custom.tree[path]['data']}]

#	system.perspective.print("Sending breadCrumbSelected msg with %s"%payload)
	system.perspective.sendMessage("breadCrumbSelected", payload=payload)

	return
